title: Edgar Fouche: the TR3B timeline from prototype to operational

tellings.quote: first actually operational proto or operational models of TR3B started to kind of fly around in the '90s. From the 70s until onward, it was prototype models.

plain: The TR3B is said to be a secret American aircraft that was built and tested as prototypes from the 1970s on, with the first working models flying in the 1990s. An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this. He passes on the account of a man named Edgar Fouche, who described the craft in a presentation at the International UFO Congress in 1998 and tied it to test sites such as the Navy's Patuxent River air station and Edwards Air Force Base. If it were true, it would mean the United States has been flying a secret, highly advanced craft for decades.
